motivation.training_obstruction: PHP_5_4 Stage-4 second elimination produced 11x11=121 raw resolution pairs, 105 non-tautological unique resolvents, zero duplicate resolvents and an explicit canonical state volume of 343 above the frozen cap 256.
motivation.target_question: Can the exact resolution cross-product be represented as a semantics-preserving latent product node without materializing every resolvent clause?
motivation.forbidden_inference: A compact representation by itself does not establish polynomial-time SAT or P=NP.

input_contract.input: A canonical exact CNF state F and one pivot variable x.
input_contract.training_fingerprint_visibility: Allowed only for the already-known PHP_5_4 training specimen; the algorithm must not branch on fingerprints.

required_partition.P: clauses containing positive x, written canonically as x OR A_i
required_partition.N: clauses containing negative x, written canonically as -x OR B_j

input_contract.tautological_input_clause_policy: Use the same canonicalization policy as the frozen C025 engine; ambiguity or malformed literals fail closed.

frozen_exact_identity.source_form: U AND (AND_i (x OR A_i)) AND (AND_j (-x OR B_j))
frozen_exact_identity.explicit_resolution_CNF_equivalent: U AND (AND_{i,j} (A_i OR B_j)), with tautological resolvents omitted under canonical CNF semantics.
frozen_exact_identity.semantic_requirement: The factorized node must denote exactly existential elimination of x from the source state. No probabilistic or approximate semantics are admitted.

frozen_representation_grammar.latent_semantics: OR(AND positive_tail_family, AND negative_tail_family) conjoined with U
frozen_representation_grammar.sharing: Tail clauses and unaffected clauses may be hash-consed/DAG-shared; sharing must be explicit in the certificate.
frozen_representation_grammar.nested_nodes: Not admitted in gate v1 unless they arise only as opaque already-verified input atoms. v1 tests one exact representation transition, not recursive totality.

must_commit: ordered or canonically sorted positive tails A_i
ordered or canonically sorted negative tails B_j
mapping from every source clause to exactly one partition role
must_not_require: materialization of every A_i OR B_j resolvent merely to establish the distributive identity

checks: pivot occurs with exactly the claimed signs
U/P/N is a total disjoint partition of source clauses
removing the pivot literal from P and N yields exactly the committed A_i and B_j tails
the node grammar denotes the frozen distributive existential-elimination identity
all referenced DAG/hash-consed atoms resolve to exact committed content
tamper_cases_required: duplicate one partition mapping while omitting another
move a clause to the wrong sign partition

resource_ledger.diagnostic_explicit_expansion: May be used only in bounded training/holdout measurement to compare semantics/resource volume; it is not part of the admitted factorized algorithm path.
resource_ledger.fixed_cap: Use the same frozen cap policy associated with the supplied Stage-4 context; the gate may not increase cap exponent after seeing the holdout.

progress_gate.local_v1_requirement: The pivot x is removed from the represented semantics and no new Boolean variable is introduced by the factor node.
progress_gate.warning: Local variable elimination with compact representation is not enough; later operations on factor nodes must themselves obtain separately preregistered polynomial resource/progress bounds.

accept_if_all: factor node is structurally valid under the frozen grammar
representation plus certificate remain within the frozen context cap
local progress strictly removes the pivot
no hidden explicit cross-product is executed on the admitted path

constructor_adversary_policy.constructor_swarm: May propose pivots or syntactically equivalent candidate factor layouts, but proposal order has no semantic authority.
constructor_adversary_policy.adversary_swarm: May search for malformed partitions, representation blowups, verifier mismatches and contexts where the factor grammar cannot be operated on compactly.

next_required_event: Freeze an independently selected non-PHP over-cap elimination-context holdout before factorizer implementation.
